First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Scout-a-Route Saturday Ride group ride

The slower of Mellow Johnny's Saturday shop rides. It rolls from the downtown shop at a 12 to 16 mph pace and explores a different route each week. The shop bills its rides as no-drop, no-ego. Check the shop's ride calendar before you go.
